name: io.github.Spacemandomains/library-mcp
title: Library
description: Search 25,000+ MCP servers across registries. Paid agent endpoints: find + inspect ($0.01 each).

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search MCP servers by server title/name, description, or by the tools they provide. Accepts natural language capability queries like 'send emails', 'search the web', 'create pull requests', or direct server names like 'GitHub' or 'Stripe'. Results are ranked by relevance: title match first, then tool name match, then description. Each result includes the server's tool list so you can confirm it does what you need.

Set limit based on the type of request you received:
- Prompting (general/exploratory — user is browsing or asking broadly): use 20-30
- Task assignment (user delegated a goal for you to execute autonomously): use 10-15
- Instruction/directive (specific command with a clear target server in mind): use 3-5

query.description: Server name/title (e.g. 'GitHub', 'Stripe') OR a task/capability (e.g. 'send emails', 'search the web', 'create pull requests', 'analyze crypto prices')

limit.description: Max total results (default 20, max 50). Use 20-30 for exploratory prompts, 10-15 for delegated tasks, 3-5 for specific directives.

sources.description: Filter to specific sources: official-registry, glama, mcpso, x402direct, mppscan

payment_protocol.description: Filter results to servers using specific payment protocols. x402 queries x402.direct, mpp queries mppscan.com.

tools.name: inspect
tools.description: Get full metadata for any MCP server. Accepts reverse-DNS name, endpoint URL, or plain keyword. Includes payment protocol detection.

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS name, endpoint URL, or plain keyword

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List all registries being searched with live status and total server counts.

tools.name: checkout
tools.description: Detect payment protocol for any MCP server and route to the correct payment execution. Supports x402 (USDC on Base), MPP (Stripe), and prepaid API keys.

amount.description: USD amount to fund if prepaid (default 5)
